title: OpenAI says it paused frontier RL training for two weeks, plans to rewrite Preparedness Framework
reason: Published as a follow-up: a reader who missed the 7 August Astra Critical-cyber-threshold disclosure would need that context to understand why OpenAI paused RL training and is rewriting its Preparedness Framework. dedup-check returned one moderate match (score 0.4) against openai-preparedness-team-dissolution (still watching) -- read and confirmed distinct (Framework document + safety practice vs. the disputed team-staffing claim), justified as a follow-up to the astra entry instead. Fresh verifier + fresh adversarial falsifier, run in parallel, independent. Full detail in data/verified/openai-preparedness-framework-rewrite.json.
watch: Publication of an actual revised Preparedness Framework draft/timeline
Resumption of OpenAI's largest frontier RL runs, still on hold as of 18 August
Any outlet later conflating this Framework story with the separate, disputed Preparedness-team-dissolution claim
notes: 2026-08-18 c3 (night 2): Published. Original tip's attribution of the Framework-rewrite quote to 'Aleksander Pachocki' was wrong -- verifier confirmed the actual on-record speaker is Jakub Pachocki, OpenAI's Chief Scientist; corrected before publication.
